cases.heading: W127 — Metadata apply accepts unknown command tags as applied
cases.limit: Python extracts production C into a compiled fixture: a curated exercises link, not a Python-to-C runtime call. Does not prove live group withdrawal or RDMA acceptance.

cases.heading: W145 — A follower commits its own unproven log tail after an InstallSnapshot
oracle_literals: snapshot does not commit the unproven tail
cases.limit: Locates the snapshot receive/install path and the concrete commit-bound regression. A graph path is not proof of Raft safety or live failover.

cases.heading: W125 — Small-file packing by default (background packer)
cases.limit: C oracle checks stale-source cancellation and ledger outcomes. Does not establish the unresolved W148 mismatch cause or full packing qualification.

cases.heading: F1 — Sweep can retire a stripe that has not been published (P1)
cases.limit: Regression covers pre-publication capacity pressure, wrong FileID and publication racing a NOT_FOUND mark. Storage transport is stubbed; live mount/failover acceptance is separate.

cases.heading: F2 — Receipt pressure permits concurrent execution of one identity (P2)
cases.limit: Production table and hash, colliding pending owners; duplicate execution is refused. Does not assert a prior duplicate durable publication occurred.

cases.heading: F3 — Raft lookup aliases indices separated by 2^32 (P2)
cases.limit: Exercises real memory and disk stores with alias indices, valid high indices, snapshots and reopening. No claim of a previously reachable client consensus exploit.

cases.heading: F4 — Sweep metadata RPCs miss the shared deadline (P2)
cases.limit: The C oracle calls efs_client_data_commit, which calls stripe_prove. Production bookkeeping with a synthetic monotonic jump and stubbed RPCs; verifies inherited absolute budget and retained obligations. Does not establish a live-cluster wall-clock timing bound.

cases.heading: F5 — Closed absent stripes with fewer than two durable fragments never retire (P2)
cases.limit: The C oracle calls efs_client_data_commit, which calls stripe_prove. Component retirement requires a publication/terminal fence followed by an authoritative absence read. GETCHUNKS transport and base/span/packed/fence cases are exercised separately in test_getchunks_budget.py. No live data-loss claim.
